resources.assets:6457.name: E Melee
resources.assets:6457.description: Swordsmen are simple melee warriors, but do not underestimate them when they come in numbers.

resources.assets:6467.name: E BarrelKnight
resources.assets:6467.description: An enchanted warrior made of wood. Counts as a siege weapon and is armored against ranged attacks. Quite sturdy and eager to cause trouble.

resources.assets:6451.name: E Ogre
resources.assets:6451.description: Ogres are huge melee warriors that really pack a punch. Hey! Due to their human heritage, ogres aren't monsters though (everybody knows that, duh).

resources.assets:5068.name: E Archer
resources.assets:5068.description: Archers shoot arrows from afar. Quite strong when left uncontested. Weak against buildings and towers.

resources.assets:6459.name: E Racer
resources.assets:6459.description: Racers are fast rolling monsters that are not messing around. They aim right for your castle center and are somewhat armored against attacks from the player character.

resources.assets:6446.name: E Moleman
resources.assets:6446.description: Can tunnel directly to its target. Takes additional damage from defense towers.

resources.assets:5077.name: E Quicksling
resources.assets:5077.description: A unique siege weapon that rapidly fires arrows at random enemies in its range. If you don't have any allied buildings or units nearby, it will quickly mow you down.

resources.assets:5071.name: E Crossbow
resources.assets:5071.description: Master Crossbowmen deal massive amounts of damage to you and your units. Best to keep yourself and your troops entirely out of range whenever you can. They are quite weak against buildings though.

resources.assets:6470.name: E Exploder
resources.assets:6470.description: Exploders are monsters that roll straight for the closest building and explode when they die. They are slightly armored against attacks from the player character.

level23:4134.name: E Eldermole
level23:4134.description: Some speculate they could be part of an ancient defense mechanism? Maybe there is a reason this castle remained abandoned for so long? No... they are just statues...

resources.assets:5073.name: E Fury
resources.assets:5073.description: A large flying monster that focusses on destroying your defenses. Their projectiles are quite slow and easy to dodge but wreak havoc when they hit.

level23:4561.name: E Eldermole
level23:4561.description: Some speculate they could be part of an ancient defense mechanism? Maybe there is a reason this castle remained abandoned for so long? No... they are just statues...

resources.assets:6462.name: E Eldermole
resources.assets:6462.description: A Mini-Boss that can tunnel directly to its target dealing massive splash damage to its surroundings. Extremely tanky. Takes additional damage from defense towers.
